producer_report.summary:
The critic and verifier now state a misread as an explicit yes/no field, so text starting 'None…' no longer stops planning or fails verification. The cause was a free-text field that Athena read as a flag whenever it was non-empty.

`CriticOutput` and `VerdictOutput` in `outputs.rs` swap `request_reading_mismatch` for a required bool `request_misread` and an optional `request_misread_reason`. `end_round` in `planning.rs` and `judge` in `verify.rs` now act only on the bool. A true bool with no reason still stops or fails, with the explanation 'no explanation given'. D93 holds: `judge` adds the major finding for a true misread. The critic path adds no finding of its own, because the critic prompt tells the critic to write it.

The stored record fields keep their type and are set only when the bool is true. So `records.rs`, old records, retry, status and display read as before, and `display.rs` and `status.rs` logic is unchanged. The prompts, the verifier prompt anchor in `verify.rs`, `lib.rs` anchors and the budget lines in `docs/system-facts.md` follow the new field. The verifier set grows by 31 tokens, within the 90 allowed. Every agent-JSON fixture uses the new keys. CHANGELOG, a new D181 in `docs/decisions.md` and `docs/records.md` are updated.

New tests replay the pbvc and sza7 openings and cover a true misread on both paths, the schema, the old-key refusal, `plan_state` and the job view. The replays use only the openings quoted in the request, mapped into the reason with the bool false; the rest is reconstructed and labelled. Athena's checks should confirm the full `cargo test --locked`: one background run hit the 10-minute limit, so I ran the crates separately instead.

open_issues: The replay tests use only the openings of the pbvc and sza7 texts quoted in the request. The rest of each text is reconstructed and labelled in the test comments, because records/ is absent. Each text is mapped into `request_misread_reason` with `request_misread` false, since old-format JSON no longer parses.

A reason sent with `request_misread` false is dropped, because the invocation record keeps no structured output. This trade-off is stated in the CHANGELOG and D181. A model that sets the boolean true with a reason beginning 'None…' still stops the job.
Records already written with a 'None for…' string in `request_reading_mismatch` still read as misreads in status and display. They are immutable (D06) and are not rewritten.
A job planned before this change cannot parse old-format critic or verifier output after it, and needs that turn rerun. The CHANGELOG and D181 say so.
The full `cargo test --locked` was not completed by me in one run. Athena's recorded checks decide that criterion.
mistakes: I started the full `cargo test --locked` in the background with the default timeout, and it was stopped at the limit with no usable result. It also held the build slot, so a policy-scan run failed once. I recovered by running each crate's suite in the foreground.
learnings: Both agent output structs use deny_unknown_fields, and `harden` lists every property as required. So a new field needs no special schema case, and old-format agent JSON stops parsing.

`check_verifier_prompt` anchors (REQUIRED_FIELDS) match consecutive words inside one clause. Clauses split on commas, colons, full stops and semicolons, so the anchor 'set request_misread true' has to sit in a single comma-free clause.
docs/system-facts.md budget lines are pinned by `system_facts_budgets_match_computed`; any prompt edit moves them, and the failure message gives the computed value.
The background `cargo test --locked` was stopped at the default 10-minute limit. The full athena-core suite alone takes about 410 s, so run crates separately in the foreground.
Edit's old_string match is by substring, so an 8-space-indented line also matches inside a 12-space-indented copy; use the exact indentation when replacing similar fixture lines.
desires: The recorded pbvc and sza7 critique and verifier texts. The snapshot has no records/, so only the openings quoted in the request are exact.
